introduction: Tennessee SNAP uses the One DHS Customer Portal for applications, document uploads and case management. Paper applications can also be requested or downloaded.
description: Tennessee SNAP uses the One DHS Customer Portal for applications, document uploads and case management. Paper applications can also be requested or downloaded.

sections.who: TDHS reviews people sharing food purchases and preparation, household finances and other SNAP rules. Work-related conditions and exemptions can affect continued eligibility.
sections.get: Approved benefits use EBT for eligible food purchases.
sections.docs:

sections.apply:
1. Apply through One DHS

    Use the state application links.

  2. Supply verification

    Upload copies and complete the eligibility interview requests.

  3. Review the decision

    Check the award and required reports.
sections.after: Follow simplified reporting and renewal notices. TDHS says it does not call or text to request your EBT number or PIN.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using SNAP eligibility, records and One DHS intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can I manage the case online?
One DHS supports uploads, changes, renewals and status checks.
TDHS asks for copies because submitted documents may not be returned.
Where can I request an interpreter?
The state lists free help through the One DHS Contact Center at 833-772-8347.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
